title: Research — Oguz Bilgiç
excerpt: Neutral field maps of markets and technology, directional theses, and company notes. Public research, evolving in the open.
content_html:
A working log of how the world is changing and what to bet on. Spaces map an industry as it is; theses are the directional bets, each with what would break it; companies are per-name notes; watches are running ledgers of deals and capital events. Read the about page, or pick a document.
